C0155.title: Baihao's 'Red Packet Hunter' Auto-Grab Software Ordered to Pay 700,000 Yuan Compensation
C0155.summary: Hangzhou Internet Court found at first instance that software such as “Red Packet Hunter,” developed and operated by Hangzhou Baihao Company and others, enabled automatic red-packet grabbing by monitoring QQ notification messages and simulating clicks, constituting unfair competition; the judgment was upheld on appeal. The software included anti-limit techniques that encouraged dishonest red-packet grabbing and the defendants were ordered to compensate Tencent 700,000 yuan.
